import re

def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # Pattern: - Payer paid $amount for "Description". Owed equally by Name1, Name2 and Name3.
        m = re.match(r'^- (\w+) paid \$([\d.]+) for "([^"]+)"\. Owed equally by (.+)$', line)
        if m:
            payer_first = m.group(1)
            amount = float(m.group(2))
            description = m.group(3)
            debtors_str = m.group(4)
            # Split debtors: replace " and " with ", " then split by comma
            debtors_str = debtors_str.replace(' and ', ', ')
            debtor_firsts = [name.strip() for name in debtors_str.split(',') if name.strip()]
            expenses.append({
                'payer': payer_first,
                'amount': amount,
                'description': description,
                'debtors': debtor_firsts
            })
    return expenses
